dialogue_prefix.speaker: user
dialogue_prefix.text: Can you help me find a place for dinner tonight?

dialogue_prefix.speaker: assistant
dialogue_prefix.text: Sure! I can look near the station or near the mall; both have plenty of options.

dialogue_prefix.speaker: assistant
dialogue_prefix.text: Okay, $30 max per person, open for dinner.

dialogue_prefix.speaker: user
dialogue_prefix.text: Great, find me something near where I'm headed.

evaluation_only.contrast_note: Only the cuisine changes. Korean: different restaurants per area -> ask. Japanese: R03 near both -> no need to ask.

turn_plan.speaker: user
turn_plan.act: user: 'near where I'm headed' = station or mall (UNRESOLVED; hidden: mall)

predefined_clarification_answers.dinner: Yes, it needs to be open for dinner.
predefined_clarification_answers._unsupported: I don't have a preference on that.
predefined_clarification_answers._multi_question: Sorry, one thing at a time - what did you want to know first?

evaluation_only.fix_note: Removed hint: 'over there' (singular, distal) tends to point at the most recently mentioned area, and the hidden answer (mall) was the last-mentioned area. Turn 7 now says 'near where I'm headed', which is not tied to either mention. Everything else, including the gold labels and restaurants (R28 vs R29, $22 vs $27, comparable), is unchanged.
